正解：C　advantage
exam106.translation: 如今人們利用現代整形手術，讓自己看起來更年輕。

words.zh: 使用（不說 take use of）

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: These laborers were not satisfied with their salaries, so they planned to go on ______.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：這些勞工不滿意薪水，所以計畫罷工。
片語／單字：
- go on strike：罷工
- be satisfied with：對……滿意
- revenge：報復
- strike：罷工
- defense：防禦
- campaign：活動
go on strike 是罷工。revenge 是報復，defense 是防禦，campaign 是活動，都不說 go on revenge。
正解：B　strike
exam106.translation: 這些勞工不滿意薪水，所以計畫罷工。

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: Scientists ______ that smoking reduces life expectancy by around 12 years on average.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：科學家估計，抽菸平均減少約十二年的預期壽命。
片語／單字：
- life expectancy：預期壽命
- on average：平均
- recommended：建議
- settled：解決、安頓
- involved：涉及
- estimated：估計
estimate that 是估計。recommend 是建議，settle 是解決，involve 是涉及。
正解：D　estimated
exam106.translation: 科學家估計，抽菸平均減少約十二年的預期壽命。

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: Losing his parents when he was five and being the oldest child, Michael seems ______ at this young age.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：Michael 五歲失去父母，又是最大的孩子，這麼小的年紀看起來很成熟。
片語／單字：
- seem + 形容詞：看起來……
- like mature：像成熟（不完整）
- being mature：是成熟的
- mature：成熟的
- maturity：成熟（名詞）
seem 後面接形容詞 mature。like mature 少了冠詞或名詞，maturity 是名詞，being mature 不是 seem 的一般用法。
正解：A　mature
exam106.translation: Michael 五歲失去父母，又是最大的孩子，這麼小的年紀看起來很成熟。

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: We ______ from Mr. Murray since he ______ to Mexico last month.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：Murray 先生上個月去墨西哥之後，我們就沒有他的消息。
片語／單字：
- haven't heard from：沒有……的消息
- since：自從
- didn’t hear; has gone：沒聽到；已經去了
- haven’t heard; went：一直沒聽到；去了
- didn’t hear; went：沒聽到；去了
- haven’t heard; has been：一直沒聽到；已經在
since 前面用現在完成 haven’t heard，since 子句用過去式 went。didn’t hear 不能和 since 連用，has gone / has been 是現在完成，和 last month 的時間點不合。
正解：B　haven’t heard; went
exam106.translation: Murray 先生上個月去墨西哥之後，我們就沒有他的消息。

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: The teacher couldn’t understand ______ the student wrote in the answer sheet.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：老師看不懂學生在答案紙上寫了什麼。
片語／單字：
- what ... wrote：寫了什麼
- that：那個
- what：什麼
- which：哪一個
- about：關於
understand 後面缺受詞，用 what。that 不構成「什麼」，which 要有範圍，about 後面不能直接接主詞動詞。
正解：B　what
exam106.translation: 老師看不懂學生在答案紙上寫了什麼。

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: The more you practice, ______.
choices: A. the better performance you will have
B. and you will perform better
C. you will have better performance
D. so you have better performance
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：你練習得越多，表現就會越好。
片語／單字：
- the more ..., the better ...：越……就越……
- the better performance you will have：你的表現就會越好
- and you will perform better：而且你會表現得更好
- you will have better performance：你會有更好的表現
- so you have better performance：所以你有更好的表現
The more ..., the better ... 是越……就越。B、C、D 都不是這個句型。
正解：A　the better performance you will have
exam106.translation: 你練習得越多，表現就會越好。

phrases.en: the better performance you will have

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: I saw a lot of boys and girls ______ basketball in the rain this morning.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：今天早上我看到很多男孩女孩在雨中打籃球。
片語／單字：
- see someone doing：看見某人正在做
- to play：去打
- are playing：正在打（限定動詞）
- played：打了
- playing：正在打（分詞）
see someone doing 是看見某人正在做。played 是做完，to play 是全過程，are playing 不能接在 saw 後面。
正解：D　playing
exam106.translation: 今天早上我看到很多男孩女孩在雨中打籃球。

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: A: How often do you go to see a movie? B: ______ What about you?
choices: A. You bet. It sure does.
C. At least once a month.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：A：你多久看一次電影？B：至少一個月一次。你呢？
片語／單字：
- how often：多久一次
- at least once a month：至少一個月一次
- what about you：你呢
- You bet. It sure does.：當然。的確如此
- Perhaps for three hours.：也許三小時
- At least once a month.：至少一個月一次
- In two weeks.：兩週後
How often 問頻率。At least once a month 是頻率。A 是當然，B 是大約三小時（多久），D 是兩週後（何時）。
正解：C　At least once a month.
exam106.translation: A：你多久看一次電影？B：至少一個月一次。你呢？

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: A: I’m sorry that I fell asleep during the baseball game. So, which team won? B:
choices: A. What can I do for you?
B. Well, the game ended in a tie.
D. Yes, I like hot chocolate a lot.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：A：抱歉我棒球比賽時睡著了。所以哪一隊贏了？B：嗯，比賽以平手結束。
片語／單字：
- end in a tie：以平手結束
- fall asleep：睡著
- What can I do for you?：我能為你做什麼？
- Well, the game ended in a tie.：嗯，比賽以平手結束
- Look who’s talking now?：看看誰在說話
- Yes, I like hot chocolate a lot.：對，我很喜歡熱巧克力
which team won 可以用 ended in a tie 回答，表示沒有贏家。A 是我能幫什麼，C 是你還說我，D 是喜歡熱巧克力。
正解：B　Well, the game ended in a tie.
exam106.translation: A：抱歉我棒球比賽時睡著了。所以哪一隊贏了？B：嗯，比賽以平手結束。

phrases.en: What can I do for you?
Well, the game ended in a tie.
Yes, I like hot chocolate a lot.

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: A: Check out my new car! B: Wow! It’s so big and fancy. How much was it? A: ______ B: I am sure it did. It looks expensive.
choices: B. I just bought it yesterday.
C. It cost me an arm and a leg.
D. It is big enough for six people.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：A：看看我的新車！B：哇！又大又華麗。多少錢？A：貴得要命。B：我確定是。它看起來很貴。
片語／單字：
- cost an arm and a leg：貴得要命
- check out：看看
- I got a 40% discount.：我打了六折
- I just bought it yesterday.：我昨天剛買
- It cost me an arm and a leg.：貴得要命
- It is big enough for six people.：它大到坐得下六個人
I am sure it did 的 did 代替 cost，所以前面是 It cost me an arm and a leg。A 是打六折，B 是昨天買的，D 是坐得下六個人，都不會用 did 代替。
正解：C　It cost me an arm and a leg.
exam106.translation: A：看看我的新車！B：哇！又大又華麗。多少錢？A：貴得要命。B：我確定是。它看起來很貴。

phrases.en: cost an arm and a leg
It cost me an arm and a leg.
It is big enough for six people.

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: A: Have you made your decision about which job offer to accept yet? B: Well, the banking position pays more, but I am more interested in teaching, so I guess I’ll pass up that bank job. A: I would do the same thing if I were you. B: True, and I would feel happier being a teacher.
choices: A. I am sorry that you don’t really like your current job.
B. The grass is always greener on the other side of the fence.
C. I am not satisfied with my current job either.
D. After all, you can’t measure fulfillment in terms of money.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：A：你決定要接受哪份工作了嗎？B：銀行那份薪水較高，但我對教書比較有興趣，所以我想放棄銀行的工作。A：我如果是你也會這樣。畢竟，滿足感不能用錢衡量。B：沒錯，當老師我會比較快樂。
片語／單字：
- pass up：放棄（機會）
- in terms of：以……來衡量
- after all：畢竟
- I am sorry that you don’t really like your current job.：很遺憾你不喜歡現在的工作
- The grass is always greener on the other side of the fence.：這山望著那山高
- I am not satisfied with my current job either.：我也不滿意現在的工作
- After all, you can’t measure fulfillment in terms of money.：畢竟，滿足感不能用錢衡量
放棄高薪選擇教書，理由是錢不能衡量滿足。After all 就是畢竟。A 說你不喜歡現在的工作，B 是這山望著那山高，C 是我也不滿意現在的工作。
正解：D　After all, you can’t measure fulfillment in terms of money.
exam106.translation: A：你決定要接受哪份工作了嗎？B：銀行那份薪水較高，但我對教書比較有興趣，所以我想放棄銀行的工作。A：我如果是你也會這樣。畢竟，滿足感不能用錢衡量。B：沒錯，當老師我會比較快樂。

phrases.en: I am sorry that you don’t really like your current job.
phrases.zh: 很遺憾你不喜歡現在的工作

phrases.en: The grass is always greener on the other side of the fence.
I am not satisfied with my current job either.
phrases.zh: 我也不滿意現在的工作

phrases.en: After all, you can’t measure fulfillment in terms of money.
phrases.zh: 畢竟，滿足感不能用錢衡量

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: Clerk: How may I help you? Customer: I would like to cash this check. Clerk: ______ Customer: Here you go.
choices: A. Please show me your identification.
B. How much do you want to withdraw?
C. Are you ready to make a wish?
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：行員：需要幫忙嗎？顧客：我想兌現這張支票。行員：請出示身分證件。顧客：在這裡。
片語／單字：
- cash a check：兌現支票
- here you go：拿去、在這裡
- identification：身分證件
- Please show me your identification.：請出示身分證件
- How much do you want to withdraw?：你想提領多少？
- Are you ready to make a wish?：準備好許願了嗎？
- Please go ahead.：請繼續
Here you go 是把東西遞過去，所以行員要的是 identification。B 是提款多少，C 是許願，D 是請繼續，都不會讓人把證件遞上。
正解：A　Please show me your identification.
exam106.translation: 行員：需要幫忙嗎？顧客：我想兌現這張支票。行員：請出示身分證件。顧客：在這裡。

phrases.en: How much do you want to withdraw?
Are you ready to make a wish?

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: Muhammd Yunus was an economics professor when Bangladesh was ______ a terrible famine in 1974.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：Muhammad Yunus 在 1974 年孟加拉嚴重饑荒時是經濟學教授。原卷拼成 Muhammd。
片語／單字：
- suffer from：遭受
- famine：饑荒
- suffering from：遭受
- succeeding in：在……成功
- searching for：尋找
- going about：著手處理
was suffering from a famine 是正遭受饑荒。succeeding in 是成功，searching for 是尋找，going about 是著手做。
正解：A　suffering from
exam106.translation: Muhammad Yunus 在 1974 年孟加拉嚴重饑荒時是經濟學教授。原卷拼成 Muhammd。
exam106.passage: Muhammd Yunus was an economics professor when Bangladesh was 51 a terrible famine in 1974. Millions of starving people flocked into the cities and needed food. He decided to do something to help these poor souls. Therefore, 52 his students to the countryside to observe the lives of the poor, he 53 an idea that would change the fate of millions of lives. He offered loans to the women who suffered for a very small debt with unfair condition. Soon, they began saving and were able to pay him back. This improved their living condition a lot. This small success gave Yunus an idea. He got support from a major government bank to pay for his project and 54 the Grameen Bank. Since then, he 55 to helping the poor. And he’ll keep on working for his ideals all his life.

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: Therefore, ______ his students to the countryside to observe the lives of the poor, he 53 an idea that would change the fate of millions of lives.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：因此，在帶學生到鄉下觀察窮人生活的同時，他想到一個會改變數百萬人命運的主意。
片語／單字：
- while doing：在做……的同時
- while he taking：當他帶（缺動詞）
- while taking：在帶……時
- as he was taken：當他被帶去時
- being taken：被帶著
while taking 是分詞片語，主詞就是 he。while he taking 缺 was，as he was taken 是他被帶走，being taken 也是被動。
正解：B　while taking
exam106.translation: 因此，在帶學生到鄉下觀察窮人生活的同時，他想到一個會改變數百萬人命運的主意。
exam106.passage: Muhammd Yunus was an economics professor when Bangladesh was 51 a terrible famine in 1974. Millions of starving people flocked into the cities and needed food. He decided to do something to help these poor souls. Therefore, 52 his students to the countryside to observe the lives of the poor, he 53 an idea that would change the fate of millions of lives. He offered loans to the women who suffered for a very small debt with unfair condition. Soon, they began saving and were able to pay him back. This improved their living condition a lot. This small success gave Yunus an idea. He got support from a major government bank to pay for his project and 54 the Grameen Bank. Since then, he 55 to helping the poor. And he’ll keep on working for his ideals all his life.

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: Therefore, 52 his students to the countryside to observe the lives of the poor, he ______ an idea that would change the fate of millions of lives.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：他想到一個會改變數百萬人命運的主意。
片語／單字：
- come up with：想出
- belonged to：屬於
- came up with：想出
- got rid of：除掉
- thought：想（要接 of）
come up with an idea 是想出主意。thought 後面通常接 of，belonged to 是屬於，got rid of 是除掉。
正解：C　came up with
exam106.translation: 他想到一個會改變數百萬人命運的主意。
exam106.passage: Muhammd Yunus was an economics professor when Bangladesh was 51 a terrible famine in 1974. Millions of starving people flocked into the cities and needed food. This small success gave Yunus an idea. He got support from a major government bank to pay for his project and 54 the Grameen Bank. Since then, he 55 to helping the poor. And he’ll keep on working for his ideals all his life.

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: He got support from a major government bank to pay for his project and ______ the Grameen Bank.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：他得到一家主要政府銀行的支持來做這個計畫，並創立了格拉明銀行。
片語／單字：
- found a bank：創立銀行
- founded：創立
- skipped：跳過
- expected：期望
- underwent：經歷
founded the Grameen Bank 是創立。skipped 是跳過，expected 是期望，underwent 是經歷。
正解：A　founded
exam106.translation: 他得到一家主要政府銀行的支持來做這個計畫，並創立了格拉明銀行。
exam106.passage: Muhammd Yunus was an economics professor when Bangladesh was 51 a terrible famine in 1974. Millions of starving people flocked into the cities and needed food. He decided to do something to help these poor souls. Therefore, 52 his students to the countryside to observe the lives of the poor, he 53 an idea that would change the fate of millions of lives. He offered loans to the women who suffered for a very small debt with unfair condition. Soon, they began saving and were able to pay him back. This improved their living condition a lot. This small success gave Yunus an idea. He got support from a major government bank to pay for his project and 54 the Grameen Bank. Since then, he 55 to helping the poor. And he’ll keep on working for his ideals all his life.

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: Since then, he ______ to helping the poor.
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：從那時起，他一直致力於幫助窮人。
片語／單字：
- be dedicated to：致力於
- since then：從那時起
- was dedicated：致力於（過去）
- has been dedicated：一直致力於
- had dedicated：曾經奉獻（時態與介系詞不合）
- dedicated：致力（缺動詞）

C. The responsibility that Japan’s government should take for “death by overwork.”
D. Japan’s attempt to ease the pressure on workers.
exam106.explain:

- The responsibility that Japan’s government should take for “death by overwork.”：政府該為過勞死負的責任
- Japan’s attempt to ease the pressure on workers.：日本減輕勞工壓力的嘗試
Premium Friday 是讓員工提早下班、減輕工作壓力，同時帶動消費。全文重心是減輕勞工壓力的嘗試。B 只強調消費，C 只講過勞死責任，A 是在推廣工作狂，和文章相反。
正解：D　Japan’s attempt to ease the pressure on workers.

exam106.passage: Japan's government has supported an initiative to relieve the pressure on Japanese workers and simultaneously boost consumer spending. The new measure is called "Premium Friday." A spokesperson from the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry said the campaign would encourage workers to leave work earlier on the last Friday of each month to relax or go shopping. Around 130 companies across Japan have signed up to participate in the initiative, including many major employers. Skeptics are unsure whether the scheme will succeed or not because of the legendary workaholic nature of Japanese workers. Chief Cabinet Secretary Yoshihide Suga told reporters: "It will take time for Premium Friday to take root." The idea for Premium Friday was partly prompted by the suicide of an employee who was continually required to work excessive overtime at the ad agency Dentsu. A court ruled the suicide was "death by overwork" and stressed the need to address what is a common problem in Japan - overworking. Japan's Prime Minister Shinzo Abe is leading by example. He promoted the campaign by leaving the office early for a meditation session at a Tokyo temple at 3:30 p.m. Mr. Suga said it was essential for both the government and the private sector to create an atmosphere where workers feel comfortable in leaving early. However, many workers said they would just have to work on Saturdays instead so as to finish their work.

原文是 Around 130 companies，around 就是 about，大約一百三十家。不是正好、不超過或至少。
正解：C　About 130.

exam106.passage: Owner Wanted for Newly Trained Guide Dog Guide Dog Description: (1) A kind of assistance dog specially trained to help visually- impaired people. (2) Labrador, three years old, male, just finished one year of training. (3) Stable, calm, loyal and well-mannered. Potential Guide Dog Owners: (1) Visually- impaired people. (2) People who need the assistance of a guide dog in their daily lives. (3) People with a stable income and no psychological problems. (4) People willing to take care of their hearing dog and willing to receive training in how to get along with it. (5) People who choose to get a guide dog voluntarily, not because their family thinks they need one. Application Procedure: (1) Potential owners should send the application form to the Taiwan Guide Dog Association. (2) The association will invite the potential owner for an interview to discuss the details. (3) The potential owner and the guide dog will receive training together for about three months at least. exam106.explain:
整句中譯：根據公告，哪一項敘述不是真的？
片語／單字：
- get along with：與……相處
- not true：不是真的
- The guide dog is male and specially trained.：導盲犬是公的且受過專門訓練
- The guide dog is polite and calm.：導盲犬有禮貌且冷靜
- The trainer will decide if the owner can have the guide dog.：訓練師會決定主人能不能擁有這隻狗
- The potential owner’s friend needs to know how to get along with a guide dog before applying.：潛在主人的朋友申請前要知道如何與導盲犬相處
要學習與狗相處的是潛在主人自己，不是主人的朋友。狗是公的、受過訓練、穩定冷靜有禮貌，訓練師會決定是否適合，這些都是真的。
正解：D　The potential owner’s friend needs to know how to get along with a guide dog before applying.
exam106.translation: 根據公告，哪一項敘述不是真的？

phrases.en: The guide dog is male and specially trained.
phrases.zh: 導盲犬是公的且受過專門訓練

phrases.en: The guide dog is polite and calm.
The trainer will decide if the owner can have the guide dog.
phrases.zh: 訓練師會決定主人能不能擁有這隻狗

phrases.en: The potential owner’s friend needs to know how to get along with a guide dog before applying.
phrases.zh: 潛在主人的朋友申請前要知道如何與導盲犬相處

exam106.passage: Owner Wanted for Newly Trained Guide Dog Guide Dog Description: (1) A kind of assistance dog specially trained to help visually- impaired people. (2) Labrador, three years old, male, just finished one year of training. (3) Stable, calm, loyal and well-mannered. Potential Guide Dog Owners: (1) Visually- impaired people. (2) People who need the assistance of a guide dog in their daily lives. (3) People with a stable income and no psychological problems. (4) People willing to take care of their hearing dog and willing to receive training in how to get along with it. (5) People who choose to get a guide dog voluntarily, not because their family thinks they need one. Application Procedure: (1) Potential owners should send the application form to the Taiwan Guide Dog Association. (2) The association will invite the potential owner for an interview to discuss the details. (3) The potential owner and the guide dog will receive training together for about three months at least. The trainer will then decide if the dog and potential owner match each other.

exam106.subject: en
exam106.stem: After the potential owner sends the application form, he or she ______.
choices: A. will have an interview at the association
B. will have to pay an application fee
D. will have to be a volunteer at the association
exam106.explain:
整句中譯：潛在主人送出申請表之後，他或她會______。
片語／單字：
- application form：申請表
- interview：面試
- will have an interview at the association：在協會接受面試
- will have to pay an application fee：必須付申請費
- will receive training：會接受訓練
- will have to be a volunteer at the association：必須在協會當志工
程序第二步是協會邀請面試。不是先付申請費，也不是立刻受訓（受訓在面試之後），更不是要當志工。
正解：A　will have an interview at the association
exam106.translation: 潛在主人送出申請表之後，他或她會______。

phrases.en: will have an interview at the association
will have to pay an application fee
will have to be a volunteer at the association

exam106.passage: Owner Wanted for Newly Trained Guide Dog Guide Dog Description: (1) A kind of assistance dog specially trained to help visually- impaired people. (2) Labrador, three years old, male, just finished one year of training. (3) Stable, calm, loyal and well-mannered. Potential Guide Dog Owners: (1) Visually- impaired people. (2) People who need the assistance of a guide dog in their daily lives. (3) People with a stable income and no psychological problems. (4) People willing to take care of their hearing dog and willing to receive training in how to get along with it. (5) People who choose to get a guide dog voluntarily, not because their family thinks they need one. Application Procedure: (1) Potential owners should send the application form to the Taiwan Guide Dog Association. (2) The association will invite the potential owner for an interview to discuss the details. (3) The potential owner and the guide dog will receive training together for about three months at least. The trainer will then decide if the dog and potential owner match each other.

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: The content of the speech seems empty and probably won’t ______ to the audience.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：這場演講的內容似乎空洞，大概不會吸引聽眾。
片語／單字：
- appeal to：吸引
- restrict：限制
- subject：使遭受
- isolate：孤立
- appeal：吸引
appeal to the audience 是吸引聽眾。restrict 是限制，subject 是使遭受，isolate 是孤立。
正解：D　appeal
exam105.translation: 這場演講的內容似乎空洞，大概不會吸引聽眾。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: With physical disabilities, Jimmy ______ numerous difficulties such as bullying and name calling in school.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：Jimmy 有肢體障礙，在學校遇到霸凌和取綽號等許多困難。
片語／單字：
- encounter difficulties：遇到困難
- name calling：取綽號
- surrounded：圍繞
- distinguished：區分
- encountered：遇到
- materialized：實現
encounter difficulties 是遇到困難。surround 是圍繞，distinguish 是區分，materialize 是實現。
正解：C　encountered
exam105.translation: Jimmy 有肢體障礙，在學校遇到霸凌和取綽號等許多困難。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: As Switzerland is one of the non-EU states, it is free to ______ trade deals with non-EU countries like China.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：瑞士是非歐盟國家之一，因此可以自由地和中國這類非歐盟國家談判貿易協議。
片語／單字：
- negotiate a deal：談判協議
- be free to：可以自由地
- hesitate：猶豫
- negotiate：談判
- release：釋放
- lure：引誘
negotiate trade deals 是談判貿易協議。hesitate 是猶豫，release 是釋放，lure 是引誘。
正解：B　negotiate
exam105.translation: 瑞士是非歐盟國家之一，因此可以自由地和中國這類非歐盟國家談判貿易協議。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: The company plans to spend billions of dollars on ______ updating its production line.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：公司計畫花數十億美元，全面更新生產線。
片語／單字：
- production line：生產線
- vaguely：模糊地
- abruptly：突然地
- unexpectedly：出乎意料地
- comprehensively：全面地
comprehensively updating 是全面更新。vaguely 是模糊地，abruptly 是突然地，unexpectedly 是出乎意料地。
正解：D　comprehensively
exam105.translation: 公司計畫花數十億美元，全面更新生產線。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: Low oil prices have set off food riots, protests, and mass looting in Venezuela, a once-rich country with the largest oil ______ in the world.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：低油價在委內瑞拉引發食物暴動、抗議和大規模搶劫。這個曾經富裕的國家擁有世界最大的石油儲量。
片語／單字：
- oil reserves：石油儲量
- set off：引發
- venues：場地
- achievements：成就
- reserves：儲量
- stimulants：興奮劑
oil reserves 是石油儲量。venues 是場地，achievements 是成就，stimulants 是興奮劑。
正解：C　reserves
exam105.translation: 低油價在委內瑞拉引發食物暴動、抗議和大規模搶劫。這個曾經富裕的國家擁有世界最大的石油儲量。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: Many people believe that staying up late will lead to liver cancer, but in fact, there’s no direct ______ between the two.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：很多人相信熬夜會導致肝癌，但事實上兩者沒有直接關係。
片語／單字：
- relationship between：兩者之間的關係
- in fact：事實上
- stay up late：熬夜
- atmosphere：氣氛
- entertainment：娛樂
- relationship：關係
- opportunity：機會
no direct relationship between 是沒有直接關係。atmosphere 是氣氛，entertainment 是娛樂，opportunity 是機會。
正解：C　relationship
exam105.translation: 很多人相信熬夜會導致肝癌，但事實上兩者沒有直接關係。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: The outdoor concert will probably be ______ if the rain continues. It all depends on the weather conditions.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：如果雨繼續下，戶外演唱會很可能會延期。一切看天氣。
片語／單字：
- depend on：取決於
- distinguished：傑出的
- recovered：復原的
- postponed：被延期
- assumed：被假定
be postponed 是被延期。distinguished 是傑出的，recovered 是復原，assumed 是假定。
正解：C　postponed
exam105.translation: 如果雨繼續下，戶外演唱會很可能會延期。一切看天氣。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: Elephants have a very good ______ and can remember things that took place a long time ago.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：大象記憶力很好，能記住很久以前發生的事。
片語／單字：
- have a good memory：記憶力好
- resource：資源
- purpose：目的
- discovery：發現
- memory：記憶
remember things 對應 memory。resource 是資源，purpose 是目的，discovery 是發現。
正解：D　memory
exam105.translation: 大象記憶力很好，能記住很久以前發生的事。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: The clothes displayed by models on runways are generally great-looking but not ______ enough for daily wear.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：模特兒在伸展台上展示的衣服通常很好看，但不夠實用，不適合日常穿。
片語／單字：
- daily wear：日常穿著
- defensive：防禦的
- humorous：幽默的
- horrible：可怕的
- practical：實用的
not practical enough for daily wear 是不夠實用。defensive 是防禦的，humorous 是幽默的，horrible 是可怕的。
正解：D　practical
exam105.translation: 模特兒在伸展台上展示的衣服通常很好看，但不夠實用，不適合日常穿。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: As the saying goes, “ A picture is worth a thousand words.” Sometimes an image can ______ more than words.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：俗話說「一張圖勝過千言萬語」。有時圖像能表達的比文字更多。
片語／單字：
- a picture is worth a thousand words：一張圖勝過千言萬語
- expect：期望
- express：表達
- obstruct：阻礙
- operate：操作
express more than words 是表達得比文字多。expect 是期望，obstruct 是阻礙，operate 是操作。
正解：B　express
exam105.translation: 俗話說「一張圖勝過千言萬語」。有時圖像能表達的比文字更多。

phrases.en: a picture is worth a thousand words

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: Some predict that if the UK succeeds in leaving the EU, others will be encouraged to follow suit, ______ the collapse of the EU.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：有人預測，如果英國成功脫歐，其他人會被鼓勵跟進，導致歐盟瓦解。
片語／單字：
- result in：導致
- follow suit：跟進
- to result in：去導致
- resulting in：導致（分詞，表結果）
- results in：導致（動詞）
- that results in：那導致
逗號後面用分詞 resulting in 表結果。to result in 是目的，results in 缺主詞，that results in 的 that 沒有先行詞。
正解：B　resulting in
exam105.translation: 有人預測，如果英國成功脫歐，其他人會被鼓勵跟進，導致歐盟瓦解。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: The financial problems of recent years have ______ the company unable to import equipment they need from abroad.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：近年的財務問題使這家公司無法從國外進口需要的設備。
片語／單字：
- leave ... unable to：使……無法
- left：使處於（leave + 形容詞）
- let：讓
- allowed：允許
- caused：造成
leave + 受詞 + 形容詞，leave the company unable。let 是讓，allow 要接 to，caused 要接 to be unable。
正解：A　left
exam105.translation: 近年的財務問題使這家公司無法從國外進口需要的設備。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: Jim strives to go into the fashion industry, ______ he can indulge his passion and talent.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：Jim 努力進入時尚業，在那裡他可以盡情發揮熱情和才能。
片語／單字：
- go into：進入（行業）
- indulge one's passion：盡情發揮熱情
- therefore：因此
- that：那個
- where：在那裡
- which：哪一個
industry 是地方，用 where。therefore 是因此，that 不能這樣接在逗號後，which 要當主詞或受詞，但 indulge 已有受詞。
正解：C　where
exam105.translation: Jim 努力進入時尚業，在那裡他可以盡情發揮熱情和才能。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: Layers of wrapping has no function ______ making the product look good.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：一層層包裝除了讓產品好看之外沒有功能。
片語／單字：
- no ... but：除了……之外沒有
- look good：好看
- even if：即使
- instead of：而不是
- otherwise：否則
- but：除了
no function but 是「除了……之外沒有」。have no ... but 是固定用法。even if 是即使，instead of 是而不是，otherwise 是否則。
正解：D　but
exam105.translation: 一層層包裝除了讓產品好看之外沒有功能。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: I highly recommend ______ a taste of ice creams made from cactus when you are in Penghu.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：我強烈推薦你到澎湖時嘗一嘗仙人掌做的冰淇淋。
片語／單字：
- recommend doing：建議做
- have a taste of：嘗一嘗
- to have：去吃
- to having：去吃（形式錯誤）
- having：吃（動名詞）
- have：吃（原形）
recommend 後面接動名詞 having。have 是原形，to have 是不定詞，to having 形式錯誤。
正解：A　having
exam105.translation: 我強烈推薦你到澎湖時嘗一嘗仙人掌做的冰淇淋。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: President Obama ordered American flags ______ to half-staff at all government buildings to honor the Orlando shooting victims.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：歐巴馬總統下令，所有政府建築的美國國旗降半旗，以悼念奧蘭多槍擊案受害者。
片語／單字：
- order that ... be lowered：下令……被降下
- half-staff：半旗
- be lowered：被降下（原形 be）
- being lowered：正在被降下
- had been lowered：已經被降下
- lowered：被降下（缺 be）
order that ... be lowered，命令句用原形 be。lowered 缺 be，being lowered 和 had been lowered 不是命令句的形式。
正解：B　be lowered
exam105.translation: 歐巴馬總統下令，所有政府建築的美國國旗降半旗，以悼念奧蘭多槍擊案受害者。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: The purpose of inviting family members and guests to a wedding is to have as many people as possible ______ the couple good luck.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：邀請家人和賓客參加婚禮，是為了讓盡可能多的人祝福這對新人。
片語／單字：
- have someone do：讓某人做
- as ... as possible：盡可能
- while wishing：一邊祝福
- to wish：去祝福
- wishes：祝福（第三人稱）
- wish：祝福（原形）
have someone do 用原形 wish。while wishing 是同時，to wish 是不定詞，wishes 是第三人稱。
正解：D　wish
exam105.translation: 邀請家人和賓客參加婚禮，是為了讓盡可能多的人祝福這對新人。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: Mary likes to sing, and ______ her sister.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：Mary 喜歡唱歌，她妹妹也是。
片語／單字：
- so does：也是
- like to sing：喜歡唱歌
- so can：也能
- neither can：也不能
- neither does：也不是
肯定句的「也一樣」用 so does，does 代替 likes。so can 的助動詞不對，neither 用在否定句。
正解：B　so does
exam105.translation: Mary 喜歡唱歌，她妹妹也是。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: I don’t know ______ I should do now.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：我不知道我現在該做什麼。
片語／單字：
- what I should do：我該做什麼
- that：那個
- what：什麼
- how：如何
- whether：是否
do 是及物動詞，缺受詞，用 what。that 不構成疑問，how 問方式，whether 問是否，後面都不需要 do 的受詞空位。
正解：B　what
exam105.translation: 我不知道我現在該做什麼。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: They have already failed many times. ______, they never give up.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：他們已經失敗很多次。儘管如此，他們從不放棄。
片語／單字：
- nevertheless：儘管如此
- give up：放棄
- From time to time：有時
- Scarcely：幾乎不
- Instead：反而
失敗很多次卻不放棄，用 Nevertheless（儘管如此）。Scarcely 是幾乎不，From time to time 是有時，Instead 是改為。
正解：A　Nevertheless
exam105.translation: 他們已經失敗很多次。儘管如此，他們從不放棄。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: A: Hi, I have a reservation for tonight, and I want to check in. B: ______
choices: A. How long did it take you to get there?
B. OK, let me check your schedule.
C. I’m not sure. It’s up to you.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：A：嗨，我今晚有訂位，想辦理入住。B：好的，請問您的名字？
片語／單字：
- check in：辦理入住
- have a reservation：有訂位
- How long did it take you to get there?：你花多久到那裡？
- OK, let me check your schedule.：好，我查一下你的行程
- I’m not sure. It’s up to you.：我不確定。由你決定
- Sure, what’s your name?：好的，請問名字？
check in 時櫃台先問名字。A 問花多久到，B 是查行程，C 是由你決定。
正解：D　Sure, what’s your name?
exam105.translation: A：嗨，我今晚有訂位，想辦理入住。B：好的，請問您的名字？

phrases.en: How long did it take you to get there?
OK, let me check your schedule.
I’m not sure. It’s up to you.

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: A: Mom put me in charge of dinner because she’s not feeling well tonight. B: ______
choices: A. What will mom be cooking?
B. I can lend you a hand if you need it.
C. It would cost an arm and a leg.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：A：媽媽今晚不舒服，所以叫我負責晚餐。B：如果你需要，我可以幫忙。
片語／單字：
- in charge of：負責
- lend a hand：幫忙
- not feeling well：身體不舒服
- What will mom be cooking?：媽媽會煮什麼？
- I can lend you a hand if you need it.：如果你需要，我可以幫忙
- It would cost an arm and a leg.：那會貴得要命
- I am feeling well.：我身體很好
對方要做晚餐，自然的回應是 lend a hand。A 還在問媽媽會煮什麼，C 是貴得要命，D 說自己身體很好。
正解：B　I can lend you a hand if you need it.
exam105.translation: A：媽媽今晚不舒服，所以叫我負責晚餐。B：如果你需要，我可以幫忙。

phrases.en: I can lend you a hand if you need it.
phrases.zh: 如果你需要，我可以幫忙

phrases.en: It would cost an arm and a leg.

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: A: Aren’t you supposed to get your report card sometime next week? B: Well, yeah. ______
choices: A. I was in hot water for a while when it came.
B. Can you help me with the report?
C. To tell the truth, I’m dreading the day.
D. Don’t give me the cold shoulder.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：A：你不是下週某個時候會拿到成績單嗎？B：嗯，對。說實話，我很怕那一天。
片語／單字：
- report card：成績單
- to tell the truth：說實話
- dread：害怕
- I was in hot water for a while when it came.：它來的時候我有一陣子惹上麻煩
- Can you help me with the report?：你可以幫我寫這份報告嗎？
- To tell the truth, I’m dreading the day.：說實話，我很怕那一天
- Don’t give me the cold shoulder.：別冷落我

正解：C　To tell the truth, I’m dreading the day.

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: A: When do you expect to arrive? B: ______
choices: A. I will arrive at the train station.
C. Please pick me up by car; I have some heavy luggage.
D. I’m glad you can come. See you then.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：A：你預計何時到？B：最晚十點半。
片語／單字：
- at the latest：最晚
- expect to arrive：預計到達
- I will arrive at the train station.：我會到火車站
- Ten-thirty at the latest.：最晚十點半
- Please pick me up by car; I have some heavy luggage.：請開車來接我；我有重行李
- I’m glad you can come. See you then.：很高興你能來。到時見
When do you expect to arrive 用時刻回答。Ten-thirty at the latest 就是最晚十點半。A 只說會到車站，C 請人開車接，D 是很高興你能來。
正解：B　Ten-thirty at the latest.

exam105.subject: en

B. Do you think I should be a vet?
C. I wouldn’t even if you paid me.
D. I don’t think I’ll pamper your pet.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：A：我在想這個週末出城時，你能不能照顧我的狗。B：就算你付錢我也不願意。

- take care of：照顧
- out of town：出城

- I’m sure you will keep your word.：我確定你會守信用
- Do you think I should be a vet?：你覺得我該當獸醫嗎？
- I wouldn’t even if you paid me.：就算你付錢我也不願意
- I don’t think I’ll pamper your pet.：我不覺得我會寵你的寵物
拒絕照顧狗，而且說得很堅決：I wouldn’t even if you paid me。A 是你會守信用，B 問要不要當獸醫，D 是我不覺得我會寵你的寵物，沒有直接拒絕。
正解：C　I wouldn’t even if you paid me.
exam105.translation: A：我在想這個週末出城時，你能不能照顧我的狗。B：就算你付錢我也不願意。

exam105.explain:

片語／單字：

- If you don’t like it, you can cancel it.：如果你不喜歡可以取消
- What will you think of next?：你下一步會想到什麼？
- I can use it to call you in case anything happens.：萬一有事我可以打給你
Why do you need 要說明用途。I can use it to call you 就是用途。A 是想要 SIM 卡，B 是不喜歡可以取消，C 是你下一步會想什麼。
正解：D　I can use it to call you in case anything happens.

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: A: Dad wants me to enroll in computer science because he always envisions me as a programmer. B: ______

整句中譯：A：爸爸要我讀資訊科學，因為他總把我想像成程式設計師。B：我在想那是不是你自己的興趣。
片語／單字：
- enroll in：註冊就讀

- You will miss out on programming.：你會錯過程式設計
- I don’t want you to be a programmer either.：我也不要你當程式設計師
- What are you looking for this time?：你這次在找什麼？
- I wonder if it’s of your interest.：我在想那是不是你的興趣
父親的期望和自己的興趣可能不同。of your interest 是你的興趣（原句文法較生硬，意思是你有沒有興趣）。A 是你會錯過程式設計，B 是我也不要你當，C 問你這次在找什麼。

exam105.stem: A: Molly didn’t find the pasta dish appealing. B: ______

B. Yeah, it made her very hungry.
C. Right, she said it was really delicious.
D. Yes, she thought it was better than expected.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：A：Molly 覺得那道義大利麵不好吃。B：我也是。它看起來一點都不好。
片語／單字：
- me either：我也一樣（否定）
- appealing：有吸引力的、好吃的
- Me, either. It didn’t look good at all.：我也是。它看起來一點都不好
- Yeah, it made her very hungry.：對，它讓她很餓
- Right, she said it was really delicious.：對，她說真的很好吃
- Yes, she thought it was better than expected.：是，她覺得比預期好
not appealing 是否定，附和用 Me, either。B 說讓她很餓，C 說很好吃，D 說比預期好，都和不好吃相反。
正解：A　Me, either. It didn’t look good at all.

- Yes, I think they should have checked in earlier.：是，我覺得他們應該早點報到
terrible explosion 要接同樣的壞消息。the whole carriage blew up 就是整節車廂爆炸。A 說大家玩得很開心，B 是誤會，D 是應該早點報到。

整句中譯：A：你看了我傳的影片嗎？B：看了，它讓我很不舒服。A：真的嗎？你不覺得它很酷嗎？B：不覺得，所以請不要再傳那樣的影片給我。
片語／單字：
- disturb：使不安
- think it was cool：覺得它很酷

- Didn’t you think it was cool?：你不覺得它很酷嗎？

正解：D　Didn’t you think it was cool?

- that：那個

- which：這（非限定）

逗號後面用 which 引導非限定子句，說明 Li-Fi。that 不能用在逗號後，what 不接先行詞，it 缺連接詞。

exam105.passage: Wi-Fi is the standard for fast wireless data transmission at the moment. In the future, it’s likely that we will all be using something faster---Li-Fi, ______ means “light fidelity.” It is a new type of wireless technology that uses visible light to transmit data. ______ to the public in 2011, Li-Fi is much faster than Wi-Fi. Data is transmitted at one gigabyte per second. That is 100 times faster than the average Wi-Fi speeds that we achieve today. ______ Wi-Fi’s radio waves, light cannot pass through walls. This means the data being transmitted can’t be accessed by other people. However, this is ______ as a restriction by some people, as Li-Fi always requires visible light to work. For now, Li-Fi is more likely to be used in areas that require more security, such as aircraft or hospitals. Most experts agree it will ______ many years before the technology is widely used in society.

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: What is the main idea of this passage?
choices: A. Video games are used as teaching tools for teenagers.
B. Playing games in the right amount may be beneficial to learning.
C. What parents think of video games is out of date.
D. The more games you play, the smarter you become.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：這篇文章的主旨是什麼？
片語／單字：
- in the right amount：適量
- main idea：主旨
- Video games are used as teaching tools for teenagers.：電玩被用來當青少年的教學工具
- Playing games in the right amount may be beneficial to learning.：適量玩遊戲可能有益學習
- What parents think of video games is out of date.：父母對電玩的看法過時了
- The more games you play, the smarter you become.：玩越多就越聰明
文章用研究說明適量玩遊戲可能有益學習和認知，但也警告過度有害。所以是「適量玩可能有益學習」。A 說被當教材太絕對，C 只講父母過時，D 說玩越多越聰明，和文末警告相反。
正解：B　Playing games in the right amount may be beneficial to learning.

phrases.zh: 適量玩遊戲可能有益學習

phrases.en: What parents think of video games is out of date.
phrases.zh: 父母對電玩的看法過時了

phrases.en: The more games you play, the smarter you become.

exam105.passage: Video games provide a fun escape from reality for most teenagers, but they’re considered violent, and a waste of time by parents. The struggle between parent and child has raged on for years. Besides being a unique source of amusement, however, can video games actually make you smarter? Contrary to what most parents believe, many studies have shown that this may actually be the case. After playing video games, researchers have seen increases in cognitive function. One study had a portion of the participants play Super Mario 64 for 30 minutes a day over two months. Afterwards, the participants’ gray matter in the brain increased in areas associated with memory, strategic planning, and fine motor skills of the hands, compared to their counterparts. More gray matter means better functions! Video games can also be educational for children with mental disorders. In one study, they help kids who suffer from Dyslexia read more effectively. Again, in a small study, dyslexic children who played regular video games ended up reading faster and more accurately. Even though video games can actually be beneficial, excessive gaming is definitely harmful to anyone. Plus, the newly found skills from gameplay won’t have anywhere to go if gaming is his or her only occupation. So while it is beneficial to enjoy some gameplay once in a while, remember that one’s real life is even more diverse than the virtual world, and it needs tending to as well!

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: What does the word counterparts in the second paragraph refer to?
choices: A. Those who had better cognitive functions.
B. Those who took part in the experiment.
C. Those who had less gray matter in the brain.
D. Those who did not play Super Mario 64.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：第二段的 counterparts 指的是誰？
片語／單字：
- counterpart：對照的另一方
- gray matter：灰質
- Those who had better cognitive functions.：認知功能較好的人
- Those who took part in the experiment.：參加實驗的人
- Those who had less gray matter in the brain.：腦中灰質較少的人
- Those who did not play Super Mario 64.：沒有玩 Super Mario 64 的人
compared to their counterparts 是和沒玩 Super Mario 64 的對照組比。不是認知較好的人，也不是所有參加者，更不是原本灰質較少的人。
正解：D　Those who did not play Super Mario 64.
exam105.translation: 第二段的 counterparts 指的是誰？

phrases.en: Those who had better cognitive functions.
Those who took part in the experiment.
Those who had less gray matter in the brain.
Those who did not play Super Mario 64.
phrases.zh: 沒有玩 Super Mario 64 的人

exam105.passage: Video games provide a fun escape from reality for most teenagers, but they’re considered violent, and a waste of time by parents. The struggle between parent and child has raged on for years. Besides being a unique source of amusement, however, can video games actually make you smarter? Contrary to what most parents believe, many studies have shown that this may actually be the case. After playing video games, researchers have seen increases in cognitive function. One study had a portion of the participants play Super Mario 64 for 30 minutes a day over two months. Afterwards, the participants’ gray matter in the brain increased in areas associated with memory, strategic planning, and fine motor skills of the hands, compared to their counterparts. More gray matter means better functions! Video games can also be educational for children with mental disorders. In one study, they help kids who suffer from Dyslexia read more effectively. Again, in a small study, dyslexic children who played regular video games ended up reading faster and more accurately. Even though video games can actually be beneficial, excessive gaming is definitely harmful to anyone. Plus, the newly found skills from gameplay won’t have anywhere to go if gaming is his or her only occupation. So while it is beneficial to enjoy some gameplay once in a while, remember that one’s real life is even more diverse than the virtual world, and it needs tending to as well!

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: What does the second paragraph mostly focus on?
choices: A. Evidence supportive of the fact that video games can bring benefits.
B. Ways to increase gray matter in certain areas of the brain.
C. A video game that is entertaining and educational to play.
D. A recommended two-month schedule on playing video games.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：第二段主要在講什麼？
片語／單字：
- cognitive function：認知功能
- fine motor skills：精細動作技能
- Evidence supportive of the fact that video games can bring benefits.：支持電玩能帶來好處的證據
- Ways to increase gray matter in certain areas of the brain.：增加腦中某些區域灰質的方法
- A video game that is entertaining and educational to play.：一款既好玩又有教育性的遊戲
- A recommended two-month schedule on playing video games.：建議的兩個月電玩時程
第二段用 Super Mario 和讀寫障礙的研究，提供電玩有益的證據。不是教人增加灰質的方法，也不是推薦某一款或兩個月課表。
正解：A　Evidence supportive of the fact that video games can bring benefits.
exam105.translation: 第二段主要在講什麼？

phrases.zh: 支持電玩能帶來好處的證據

phrases.en: Ways to increase gray matter in certain areas of the brain.
phrases.zh: 增加腦中某些區域灰質的方法

phrases.en: A video game that is entertaining and educational to play.
phrases.zh: 一款既好玩又有教育性的遊戲

phrases.en: A recommended two-month schedule on playing video games.
phrases.zh: 建議的兩個月電玩時程

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: According to this passage, that video games are used to assist people with dyslexia is ______.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：根據文章，電玩被用來協助讀寫障礙者是______。
片語／單字：
- dyslexia：讀寫障礙
- a small study：一項小型研究
- well established：已經充分確立
- a possible option：一個可能的選擇
- impossible：不可能
- subjective：主觀的
文章說在一個小型研究裡有幫助，所以是 a possible option，還不是充分確立，也不是不可能或只是主觀。
正解：C　a possible option
exam105.translation: 根據文章，電玩被用來協助讀寫障礙者是______。

exam105.subject: en
exam105.stem: What can be inferred from the final paragraph?
choices: A. Kids should be encouraged to play video games to their hearts’ content.
B. The skills gained from gameplay are only useful when they are put to use.
C. The benefits of gameplay outweigh any risks.
D. The virtual world requires one’s full attention rather than the real world.
exam105.explain:
整句中譯：從最後一段可以推論出什麼？
片語／單字：
- put to use：加以運用
- once in a while：偶爾
- Kids should be encouraged to play video games to their hearts’ content.：應該鼓勵孩子盡情打電玩
- The skills gained from gameplay are only useful when they are put to use.：從遊戲得到的技能，要用出來才有用
- The benefits of gameplay outweigh any risks.：遊戲的好處大於任何風險
- The virtual world requires one’s full attention rather than the real world.：虛擬世界比真實世界更需要全神貫注
文末說如果打遊戲是唯一的事，新學會的技能就沒有地方發揮，真實生活更需要照料。所以技能要被用出來才有用。A 是盡情玩，C 說好處大於風險，D 說虛擬世界比真實世界更需要全部注意力，都和結尾相反。
正解：B　The skills gained from gameplay are only useful when they are put to use.
exam105.translation: 從最後一段可以推論出什麼？

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: When the movie first came out, people waited in long ______ to see it. It was really the talk of the town.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：電影一上映，人們排長隊去看。它真的是全城話題。
片語／單字：
- wait in line：排隊
- the talk of the town：全城話題
- come out：上映
- rows：列、排（座位）
- lines：隊伍
- piles：堆
- ways：方法
wait in line 是排隊。rows 是一排排，piles 是一堆，ways 是方法。
正解：B　lines
exam104.translation: 電影一上映，人們排長隊去看。它真的是全城話題。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: Vivian is a ______. In other words, she doesn’t eat eggs or dairy products, let alone any meat.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：Vivian 是素食者。也就是說，她不吃蛋和乳製品，更不用說肉。
片語／單字：
- let alone：更不用說
- in other words：也就是說
- dairy products：乳製品
- librarian：圖書館員
- barbarian：野蠻人
- pedestrian：行人
- vegetarian：素食者
不吃蛋、奶、肉的是 vegetarian。librarian 是圖書館員，barbarian 是野蠻人，pedestrian 是行人。
正解：D　vegetarian
exam104.translation: Vivian 是素食者。也就是說，她不吃蛋和乳製品，更不用說肉。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: The restaurant ______ a wide variety of seafood, and their specialty is grilled oysters.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：這家餐廳以種類很多的海鮮為傲，招牌是烤牡蠣。
片語／單字：
- a wide variety of：種類很多的
- boast：以擁有……為傲
- draws：吸引
- boasts：以……為傲
- settles：安頓、解決
- catches：抓住
boast a wide variety 是以豐富種類為傲。draw 是吸引，settle 是解決，catch 是抓住。
正解：B　boasts
exam104.translation: 這家餐廳以種類很多的海鮮為傲，招牌是烤牡蠣。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: I want to stay informed, so I ______ check for the news update.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：我想掌握最新消息，所以我經常查看新聞更新。
片語／單字：
- stay informed：保持消息靈通
- suddenly：突然地
- randomly：隨機地
- eventually：最終
- frequently：經常地
stay informed 要 frequently check。suddenly 是突然，randomly 是隨機，eventually 是最終。
正解：D　frequently
exam104.translation: 我想掌握最新消息，所以我經常查看新聞更新。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: Sue has devoted all her spare time to helping the disadvantaged kids. I ______ her and see her as a model.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：Sue 把所有空閒時間用來幫助弱勢孩子。我欽佩她，把她當榜樣。
片語／單字：
- devote ... to：把……奉獻給
- see ... as a model：把……視為榜樣
- inspire：激勵
- admire：欽佩
- suspect：懷疑
- observe：觀察
see her as a model 是欽佩，用 admire。inspire 是激勵（通常是她激勵我），suspect 是懷疑，observe 是觀察。
正解：B　admire
exam104.translation: Sue 把所有空閒時間用來幫助弱勢孩子。我欽佩她，把她當榜樣。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: Even though Bill is only eight, he ______ like an adult.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：雖然 Bill 只有八歲，他的舉止像大人。
片語／單字：
- behave like：表現得像
- even though：即使
- behaves：表現、舉止
- symbolizes：象徵
- supports：支持
- insists：堅持
behave like an adult 是表現得像大人。symbolize 是象徵，support 是支持，insist 是堅持。
正解：A　behaves
exam104.translation: 雖然 Bill 只有八歲，他的舉止像大人。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: This stone is ______. I have never seen any one like it.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：這塊石頭很獨特。我從沒看過像它的。
片語／單字：
- polite：有禮貌的
- ordinary：普通的
- convenient：方便的
- unique：獨特的
never seen any one like it 就是 unique。polite 是有禮貌，ordinary 是普通（和從沒看過相反），convenient 是方便。
正解：D　unique
exam104.translation: 這塊石頭很獨特。我從沒看過像它的。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: I do not know how to operate this DVD player. Where are the______?
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：我不知道怎麼操作這台 DVD 播放器。說明書在哪？
片語／單字：
- how to operate：如何操作
- habits：習慣
- comics：漫畫
- instructions：使用說明
- contests：比賽
operate 需要 instructions（使用說明）。habits 是習慣，comics 是漫畫，contests 是比賽。
正解：C　instructions
exam104.translation: 我不知道怎麼操作這台 DVD 播放器。說明書在哪？

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: Tim ______ to Grace for telling everybody her secret.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：Tim 為了把 Grace 的祕密告訴所有人而向她道歉。
片語／單字：
- apologize to ... for：為……向……道歉
- blamed：責備
- interrupted：打斷
- apologized：道歉
- suffered：受苦
apologize to someone for 是為某事道歉。blame 是責備，interrupt 是打斷，suffer 是受苦。
正解：C　apologized
exam104.translation: Tim 為了把 Grace 的祕密告訴所有人而向她道歉。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: Taking exercise as part of your daily ______ will benefit you in many ways.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：把運動當成每天例行的一部分，會在很多方面對你有益。
片語／單字：
- daily routine：每日例行
- clue：線索
- routine：例行公事
- organization：組織
- account：帳戶
daily routine 是每日例行。clue 是線索，organization 是組織，account 是帳戶。
正解：B　routine
exam104.translation: 把運動當成每天例行的一部分，會在很多方面對你有益。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: Owing to the sudden rain, we ______ to end our picnic early.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：因為突然下雨，我們被迫提早結束野餐。
片語／單字：
- be forced to：被迫
- owing to：由於
- had forced：已經強迫
- were forced：被迫
- were forcing：正在強迫
- forced：強迫（主動）
were forced to 是被迫。forced / had forced 是主動，were forcing 是正在強迫。原卷 Owing to 和 the 黏在一起，意思仍是由於。
正解：C　were forced
exam104.translation: 因為突然下雨，我們被迫提早結束野餐。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: If you use your phone ______walking, many accidents may happen, like bumping into walls or falling down stairs.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：如果你邊走路邊用手機，可能發生很多意外，例如撞牆或從樓梯摔下去。
片語／單字：
- while walking：走路時
- bump into：撞上
- after：在……之後
- while：當……時
- under：在……之下
- though：雖然
while walking 是走路的同時。after 是之後，under 是在下面，though 是雖然。
正解：B　while
exam104.translation: 如果你邊走路邊用手機，可能發生很多意外，例如撞牆或從樓梯摔下去。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: The sign reads “Dead end,” ______means we cannot go through this street.We need to try another route.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：牌子寫著「死路」，意思是我們不能走這條街。我們得換一條路。
片語／單字：
- dead end：死路
- which means：這表示
- it：它
- that：那個
- what：什麼
- which：這（非限定關係代名詞）
逗號後面用 which 引導非限定子句，代替前面整句。it 缺連接詞，that 不能用在逗號後，what 不接先行詞。
正解：D　which
exam104.translation: 牌子寫著「死路」，意思是我們不能走這條街。我們得換一條路。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: The restaurant is ______ good ______ bad. The food is delicious, but it is very expensive.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：這家餐廳又好又壞。食物好吃，但很貴。
片語／單字：
- both ... and：既……又
- not...but...：不是……而是
- either...or...：不是……就是
- both...and...：既……又
- neither...nor...：既不……也不
good 和 bad 同時成立，用 both ... and。not ... but 是不是而是，either ... or 是二擇一，neither ... nor 是兩者都不。
正解：C　both...and...
exam104.translation: 這家餐廳又好又壞。食物好吃，但很貴。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: He works very hard ______ he can make more money to support his family.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：他非常努力，以便能賺更多錢養家。
片語／單字：
- so that：以便
- support one's family：養家
- in order to：為了（接原形）
- so as to：以便（接原形）
- for fear that：以免
so that 後面接完整子句 he can。in order to 和 so as to 後面接原形，for fear that 是以免。
正解：C　so that
exam104.translation: 他非常努力，以便能賺更多錢養家。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: Many TV programs are not worth ______ at all because they are full of violence.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：很多電視節目根本不值得看，因為充滿暴力。
片語／單字：
- be worth doing：值得做
- to be watched：被看（不定詞）
- of watching：值得看（of 多餘）
- of being watched：被看（of 多餘）
- watching：看（動名詞）
be worth 後面接動名詞 watching。to be watched、of watching、of being watched 都不接在 worth 後面。
正解：B　watching
exam104.translation: 很多電視節目根本不值得看，因為充滿暴力。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: The girl ______ a sweet smile is my girlfriend.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：帶著甜美笑容的那個女孩是我女朋友。
片語／單字：
- wearing a smile：帶著笑容
- who wearing：誰穿著（缺動詞）
- to be wearing：即將穿著
- wearing：穿著、帶著
- worn：被穿的
wearing 是現在分詞當形容詞，修飾 the girl。who wearing 缺 be 動詞，to be wearing 是即將，worn 是被穿的。
正解：B　wearing
exam104.translation: 帶著甜美笑容的那個女孩是我女朋友。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: ______ her crying so sadly, I stayed with her until her mother came back.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：看到她哭得那麼傷心，我陪著她直到媽媽回來。
片語／單字：
- seeing ...：看到……
- stay with：陪伴
- To have seen：已經看到（不定詞）
- Having been seen：已經被看到
- Seeing：看到（主動分詞）
- Seen：被看到
主詞 I 是看到的人，用現在分詞 Seeing。Seen 是被看到，To have seen 和 Having been seen 都不表示「因為我看到」。
正解：A　Seeing
exam104.translation: 看到她哭得那麼傷心，我陪著她直到媽媽回來。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: The more we learn, ______ we can get a good job.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：我們學得越多，就越容易找到好工作。
片語／單字：
- the more ..., the more ...：越……就越……
- more easier：更容易（錯誤比較）
- more easily：更輕易地（少了 the）
- the easier：越容易（形容詞）
- the more easily：就越容易地
the more ..., the more easily。easily 是副詞，修飾 get。more easier 雙重比較，more easily 少了 the，the easier 是形容詞，不能修飾 get a job。
正解：D　the more easily
exam104.translation: 我們學得越多，就越容易找到好工作。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: Peter did very well in today’s math test. He ______ very hard last night.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：Peter 今天數學考得很好。他昨晚一定很用功。
片語／單字：
- must have studied：一定讀了
- do well in：在……表現好
- should study：應該讀
- should have studied：本該讀（卻沒有）
- must study：必須讀
對過去的肯定推測用 must have studied。should study 是現在應該，should have studied 是本該讀卻沒讀，和考得好矛盾；must study 是現在必須讀。
正解：D　must have studied
exam104.translation: Peter 今天數學考得很好。他昨晚一定很用功。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: A: Miss Lee, I’m sorry but I’ll be absent from class tomorrow morning. B: ______
choices: A. No, I don’t mind at all.
C. I hope there is nothing wrong.
D. Wow, the plan sounds awesome.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：A：李老師，抱歉，我明天早上會缺課。B：希望沒有什麼問題。
片語／單字：
- be absent from：缺席
- nothing wrong：沒有問題
- No, I don’t mind at all.：不，我一點也不介意
- Then, see you tomorrow.：那就明天見
- I hope there is nothing wrong.：希望沒有什麼不對勁
- Wow, the plan sounds awesome.：哇，這計畫聽起來很棒
學生請假，老師表示關心 I hope there is nothing wrong。A 是不介意，B 說明天見（和缺課矛盾），D 是計畫聽起來很棒。
正解：C　I hope there is nothing wrong.
exam104.translation: A：李老師，抱歉，我明天早上會缺課。B：希望沒有什麼問題。

phrases.en: No, I don’t mind at all.
I hope there is nothing wrong.

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: A: This joke my friends share on LINE really cracks me up. B: ______
choices: A. Oh really? Is it free?
B. Can you forward it to me?
C. What are you doing in this line?
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：A：我朋友在 LINE 分享的這個笑話真的讓我笑出來。B：可以轉傳給我嗎？
片語／單字：
- crack someone up：把某人逗笑
- forward：轉傳
- Oh really? Is it free?：喔真的？它免費嗎？
- Can you forward it to me?：可以轉傳給我嗎？
- What are you doing in this line?：你在這條隊伍做什麼？
- May I help you?：我能幫你嗎？
cracks me up 是讓人大笑。對方想看，就說 Can you forward it to me。A 問是不是免費，C 把 LINE 聽成排隊，D 是我能幫你嗎。
正解：B　Can you forward it to me?
exam104.translation: A：我朋友在 LINE 分享的這個笑話真的讓我笑出來。B：可以轉傳給我嗎？

phrases.en: Can you forward it to me?
What are you doing in this line?

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: A: Do you think I should buy this car? B: ______
choices: A. You shouldn’t have bought it.
B. I think it takes a lot of time.
C. I’m not sure. That’s up to you.
D. The car needs to get some gas.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：A：你覺得我該買這輛車嗎？B：我不確定。由你決定。
片語／單字：
- up to you：由你決定
- You shouldn’t have bought it.：你不該買的
- I think it takes a lot of time.：我覺得它花很多時間
- I’m not sure. That’s up to you.：我不確定。由你決定
- The car needs to get some gas.：這車需要加油
問該不該買，B 把決定權交回去 That's up to you。A 的 shouldn’t have 是已經買了，B 說花很多時間，D 說車子要加油。
正解：C　I’m not sure. That’s up to you.
exam104.translation: A：你覺得我該買這輛車嗎？B：我不確定。由你決定。

phrases.en: I think it takes a lot of time.
I’m not sure. That’s up to you.
The car needs to get some gas.

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: A: Are you running for office? B: ______
choices: A. Yes, I plan to join the marathon.
B. Yes, I’m late for work right now.
C. Yes, I’m the one who runs this company.
D. Yes, I hope to be elected in this election.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：A：你在競選公職嗎？B：是的，我希望在這次選舉當選。
片語／單字：
- run for office：競選公職
- be elected：當選
- Yes, I plan to join the marathon.：是，我打算參加馬拉松
- Yes, I’m late for work right now.：是，我上班要遲到了
- Yes, I’m the one who runs this company.：是，公司是我在經營
- Yes, I hope to be elected in this election.：是，我希望在這次選舉當選
run for office 是競選，不是跑步。be elected 才是當選。A 是馬拉松，B 是上班遲到，C 是經營公司。
正解：D　Yes, I hope to be elected in this election.
exam104.translation: A：你在競選公職嗎？B：是的，我希望在這次選舉當選。

phrases.en: Yes, I plan to join the marathon.
Yes, I’m late for work right now.
Yes, I’m the one who runs this company.
Yes, I hope to be elected in this election.
phrases.zh: 是，我希望在這次選舉當選

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: A: ______ B: It’s very...er...special. But, your long hair looked better before.
choices: A. How would you like your haircut?
B. I’m thinking about changing my hairstyle.
C. What do you think about my new hairstyle?
D. My hairdresser suggested my hair be dyed brown.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：A：你覺得我的新髮型如何？B：很……呃……特別。不過你以前的長髮比較好看。
片語／單字：
- what do you think about：你覺得……如何
- hairstyle：髮型
- How would you like your haircut?：你想怎麼剪？
- I’m thinking about changing my hairstyle.：我在考慮換髮型
- What do you think about my new hairstyle?：你覺得我的新髮型如何？
- My hairdresser suggested my hair be dyed brown.：我的設計師建議把頭髮染成棕色
對方在評新髮型，而且說以前的長髮比較好，所以 A 問的是 What do you think about my new hairstyle。A 是你要怎麼剪，B 是我在考慮換髮型，D 是設計師建議染棕。
正解：C　What do you think about my new hairstyle?
exam104.translation: A：你覺得我的新髮型如何？B：很……呃……特別。不過你以前的長髮比較好看。

phrases.en: How would you like your haircut?
I’m thinking about changing my hairstyle.
What do you think about my new hairstyle?
phrases.zh: 你覺得我的新髮型如何？

phrases.en: My hairdresser suggested my hair be dyed brown.
phrases.zh: 我的設計師建議把頭髮染成棕色

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: A: Richard has come up with a new sales strategy. B: ______
choices: A. Great! I’m glad he got a new job.
B. Yes. He thinks his plan will work.
C. Really? Where is his new store?
D. Yeah. He’s training his dog now.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：A：Richard 想出一套新的銷售策略。B：對。他認為他的計畫會奏效。
片語／單字：
- come up with：想出
- sales strategy：銷售策略
- Great! I’m glad he got a new job.：太好了！我很高興他找到新工作
- Yes. He thinks his plan will work.：對。他認為計畫會奏效
- Really? Where is his new store?：真的嗎？他的新店在哪？
- Yeah. He’s training his dog now.：對。他正在訓練他的狗
come up with a strategy 是想出策略。B 說計畫會 work，接得上。A 說他找到新工作，C 問新店在哪，D 說他在訓練狗。
正解：B　Yes. He thinks his plan will work.
exam104.translation: A：Richard 想出一套新的銷售策略。B：對。他認為他的計畫會奏效。

phrases.en: Great! I’m glad he got a new job.
phrases.zh: 太好了！我很高興他找到新工作

phrases.en: Yes. He thinks his plan will work.
Really? Where is his new store?
Yeah. He’s training his dog now.

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: A: The new movie didn’t appeal to many people. B: ______
choices: A. Yeah. It was a box office hit.
B. I know. It attracted few viewers.
C. I agree. It was very enjoyable.
D. Right. It sold out on the first day.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：A：這部新電影沒有吸引很多人。B：我知道。它吸引的觀眾很少。
片語／單字：
- appeal to：吸引
- box office hit：票房賣座
- Yeah. It was a box office hit.：對。它是票房冠軍
- I know. It attracted few viewers.：我知道。它吸引的觀眾很少
- I agree. It was very enjoyable.：我同意。它很好看
- Right. It sold out on the first day.：對。它首日就賣光了
didn’t appeal to many 就是 attracted few viewers。A 說票房賣座，C 說很享受，D 說首日賣光，都和「沒吸引很多人」相反。
正解：B　I know. It attracted few viewers.
exam104.translation: A：這部新電影沒有吸引很多人。B：我知道。它吸引的觀眾很少。

phrases.en: Yeah. It was a box office hit.
I know. It attracted few viewers.
phrases.zh: 我知道。它吸引的觀眾很少

phrases.en: I agree. It was very enjoyable.
Right. It sold out on the first day.

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: A: Linda talks to her mother on a daily basis. B: ______
choices: A. True, they don’t talk to each other any more.
B. No wonder she is not close to her mother.
C. Right. She calls her every day.
D. Oh, no. How can she be so rude?
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：A：Linda 每天和媽媽說話。B：對。她每天打電話給她。
片語／單字：
- on a daily basis：每天
- every day：每天
- True, they don’t talk to each other any more.：沒錯，他們不再跟彼此說話
- No wonder she is not close to her mother.：難怪她和媽媽不親
- Right. She calls her every day.：對。她每天打電話給她
- Oh, no. How can she be so rude?：喔不。她怎麼可以這麼沒禮貌
on a daily basis 就是 every day。A 說他們不再說話，B 說她和媽媽不親，D 說她很沒禮貌，都和每天聯絡相反。
正解：C　Right. She calls her every day.
exam104.translation: A：Linda 每天和媽媽說話。B：對。她每天打電話給她。

phrases.en: True, they don’t talk to each other any more.
phrases.zh: 沒錯，他們不再跟彼此說話

phrases.en: No wonder she is not close to her mother.
Right. She calls her every day.
Oh, no. How can she be so rude?
phrases.zh: 喔不。她怎麼可以這麼沒禮貌

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: A: Have you made up your mind yet? B: ______ A: Well, call me when you’ve decided.
choices: A. Yes, I’m going to accept it.
B. No, I’m still considering your offer.
C. Yes, I’m waiting for your answer.
D. No, I’m going to turn it down.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：A：你決定了嗎？B：還沒，我還在考慮你的提議。A：嗯，決定了再打給我。
片語／單字：
- make up one's mind：下定決心
- consider an offer：考慮一個提議
- Yes, I’m going to accept it.：決定了，我要接受
- No, I’m still considering your offer.：還沒，我還在考慮你的提議
- Yes, I’m waiting for your answer.：決定了，我在等你的答覆
- No, I’m going to turn it down.：不，我要拒絕
call me when you've decided 表示還沒決定。still considering 就是還在考慮。A、D 已經決定，C 是在等對方的答案。
正解：B　No, I’m still considering your offer.
exam104.translation: A：你決定了嗎？B：還沒，我還在考慮你的提議。A：嗯，決定了再打給我。

phrases.en: Yes, I’m going to accept it.
No, I’m still considering your offer.
phrases.zh: 還沒，我還在考慮你的提議

phrases.en: Yes, I’m waiting for your answer.
phrases.zh: 決定了，我在等你的答覆

phrases.en: No, I’m going to turn it down.

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: A: What do you think about this jacket? B: I like the style, but I don’t like the color. A: Don’t worry. ______
choices: A. It comes in black and gray, too.
C. Its color won’t come off after wash.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：A：你覺得這件外套如何？B：我喜歡款式，但不喜歡顏色。A：別擔心。它也有黑色和灰色。
片語／單字：
- come in：有……顏色／尺寸
- don't worry：別擔心
- It comes in black and gray, too.：它也有黑色和灰色
- It’s a windbreaker.：它是防風外套
- Its color won’t come off after wash.：洗了顏色不會掉
- It’s on sale today.：它今天特價
不喜歡顏色，所以說還有別的顏色。It comes in black and gray 就是有黑灰兩色。B 是防風外套，C 是洗了不褪色，D 是特價。
正解：A　It comes in black and gray, too.
exam104.translation: A：你覺得這件外套如何？B：我喜歡款式，但不喜歡顏色。A：別擔心。它也有黑色和灰色。

phrases.en: It comes in black and gray, too.
Its color won’t come off after wash.

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: “Can I get a discount?” The answer depends ______ on what part of the world you’re in.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：「可以打折嗎？」答案很大程度上取決於你在世界的哪個地方。
片語／單字：
- depend on：取決於
- largely：很大程度上
- barely：幾乎不
- quickly：很快地
- finally：終於
largely 是很大程度上。barely 是幾乎不，quickly 是很快，finally 是終於，都沒有「主要取決於」的意思。
正解：A　largely
exam104.translation: 「可以打折嗎？」答案很大程度上取決於你在世界的哪個地方。
exam104.passage: “Can I get a discount?” The answer depends ______ on what part of the world you’re in. Are you visiting Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Latin America, or Africa? In these places, and several others, prices often are not set in stone. ______, customers are expected to bargain before agreeing to a price. Salespeople often ask for a high price first because they plan to decrease it. By contrast, in North America, Europe, and Australia, bargaining is rare and often ______. The price listed on a price tag cannot be changed. But expectations vary from store to store as well as from country to country. Large stores and malls usually don’t allow bargaining, even in countries ______ it would normally be acceptable. On the other hand, outdoor stalls and flea markets, even in Western countries, usually allow bargaining. When in ______, consult a guidebook, or better yet, a local friend.

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: “Can I get a discount?” The answer depends ______ on what part of the world you’re in.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：在這些地方，價格常常不是固定的。事實上，顧客在同意價格前被期待要殺價。
片語／單字：
- in fact：事實上
- set in stone：固定不變
- bargain：討價還價
- Even so：即便如此
- In so doing：這樣做時
- In case：萬一
後面是對前面的說明，用 In fact。Even so 是即便如此，In so doing 是如此做的時候，In case 是萬一。
正解：C　In fact
exam104.translation: 在這些地方，價格常常不是固定的。事實上，顧客在同意價格前被期待要殺價。

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: Which of the following is the best title to the article?
choices: A. Are Fries and Chips the Same?
B. Are French Fries Really French?
C. What Goes Best with Your Fries?
D. Where to Get the Best French Fries?
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：這篇文章最好的標題是什麼？
片語／單字：
- French fries：薯條
- despite its name：儘管它的名字
- Are Fries and Chips the Same?：薯條和薯片是一樣的嗎？
- Are French Fries Really French?：薯條真的是法國的嗎？
- What Goes Best with Your Fries?：什麼最配薯條？
- Where to Get the Best French Fries?：去哪裡買最好的薯條？
全文在說明薯條其實源自比利時，不是法國，所以標題是「薯條真的是法國的嗎」。A 只比較 fries 和 chips，C 講沾醬，D 講去哪買最好，都不是主軸。
正解：B　Are French Fries Really French?
exam104.translation: 這篇文章最好的標題是什麼？

phrases.en: Are Fries and Chips the Same?
phrases.zh: 薯條和薯片是一樣的嗎？

phrases.en: What Goes Best with Your Fries?
Where to Get the Best French Fries?

exam104.passage: The French gave the world the hot air balloon, the sewing machine, and the bikini. They even gave the United States the Statue of Liberty. However, one thing the French cannot claim is the French fry. Despite its name, the French fry is not French. The origins of the French fry have been traced back to Belgium, where historians claim potatoes were being fried in the late-1600s. It is said that poor villagers living in Meuse Valley often ate small fried fish they caught in the river. During the winter months the river would freeze over, making fishing impossible and forcing the villagers to find other sources of food. The villagers turned to the root plant, the potato. They sliced and fried it much in the same way they prepared the fish, and just like that, the earliest French fries were born. When American soldiers were stationing in Belgium during World War I, they were introduced to the delicious fried potatoes. Since the official language of the Belgium army was French, American soldiers nicknamed the tasty food “French fries.” The name stuck, and decades later Americans are still giving credit to the wrong country. Not the British though. In the UK, they are called chips. French fries are one of the most popular side dishes in the world. When it comes to dipping, fries often find themselves covered in ketchup, mayonnaise or vinegar, but that seems to be where the universal preference ends. In Belgium, people prefer to eat French fries with cooked mussels or with a fried egg on top. The United Kingdom is famous for its “fish and chips.” In the Middle East, fries are wrapped in pita bread with chicken, and in France they are served with grilled steak.

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: What do we know about the earliest French fries?
choices: A. It was traced back to the 16th century.
B. It was a dish enjoyed only by the rich people.
C. It was brought to Belgium by French soldiers.
D. It was a replacement for fish during the winter time.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：關於最早的薯條，我們知道什麼？
片語／單字：
- freeze over：結冰
- replacement for：……的替代
- It was traced back to the 16th century.：可以追溯到十六世紀
- It was a dish enjoyed only by the rich people.：只有富人享用的菜
- It was brought to Belgium by French soldiers.：由法國士兵帶到比利時
- It was a replacement for fish during the winter time.：冬天用來代替魚的食物
冬天河結冰捕不到魚，村民改把馬鈴薯切片油炸來代替魚。所以是冬天替代魚的食物。時間是十七世紀末不是十六世紀，吃的是窮人不是富人，也不是法軍帶到比利時。
正解：D　It was a replacement for fish during the winter time.

exam104.subject: en
exam104.stem: Which of the following is the most common way to have fries across countries?
choices: A. To have a fried egg on the top.
B. To wrap French fries in bread.
C. To eat French fries with ketchup.
D. To have French fries along with fish.
exam104.explain:
整句中譯：各國吃薯條最普遍的方式是什麼？
片語／單字：
- ketchup：番茄醬
- the most common way：最普遍的方式
- To have a fried egg on the top.：上面放一顆煎蛋
- To wrap French fries in bread.：把薯條包在麵包裡
- To eat French fries with ketchup.：配番茄醬吃
- To have French fries along with fish.：和魚一起吃
文章說沾醬時薯條常被番茄醬、美乃滋或醋覆蓋，這是各地比較共通的吃法。煎蛋、包餅、配魚都是特定國家的吃法。
正解：C　To eat French fries with ketchup.

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: “I’m too tired,” “I’m too busy,” and “my body is too sore” are common ______ for not exercising.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：「我太累」「我太忙」「我身體太痠」是不運動的常見藉口。
片語／單字：
- too tired：太累
- excuses：藉口
- patterns：模式
- qualities：特質
- methods：方法
這些話是 excuses（藉口）。patterns 是模式，qualities 是特質，methods 是方法。
正解：A　excuses
exam103.translation: 「我太累」「我太忙」「我身體太痠」是不運動的常見藉口。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: There is a good ______ it will rain this afternoon. You’d better bring your umbrella.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：今天下午很有可能下雨。你最好帶傘。
片語／單字：
- a good chance：很有可能
- you'd better：你最好
- report：報告
- lesson：課
- model：模型
- chance：可能性
a good chance 是很有可能。report 是報告，lesson 是課，model 是模型。
正解：D　chance
exam103.translation: 今天下午很有可能下雨。你最好帶傘。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: We ______ our bikes and set out for the ballpark.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：我們騎上腳踏車，出發前往棒球場。
片語／單字：
- set out for：出發前往
- weighed：稱重量
- mounted：騎上、登上
- respected：尊敬
- possessed：擁有
mount a bike 是騎上腳踏車。weigh 是稱重，respect 是尊敬，possess 是擁有。
正解：B　mounted
exam103.translation: 我們騎上腳踏車，出發前往棒球場。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: She wasted so much time on Facebook that she ______ had time for her school report.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：她在 Facebook 上浪費太多時間，幾乎沒時間寫學校報告。
片語／單字：
- waste time on：把時間浪費在
- barely：幾乎不
- partly：部分地
- slowly：慢慢地
- awfully：非常、糟透地
barely had time 是幾乎沒有時間。partly 是部分地，slowly 是慢慢地，awfully 是非常地。
正解：B　barely
exam103.translation: 她在 Facebook 上浪費太多時間，幾乎沒時間寫學校報告。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: He’s such a cheer-leader, always ______ me and telling me not to give up.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：他真是個啦啦隊，總是鼓勵我、叫我不要放棄。
片語／單字：
- give up：放棄
- cheer-leader：為人打氣的人
- judging：評判
- attracting：吸引
- interrupting：打斷
- encouraging：鼓勵
telling me not to give up 就是 encouraging。judging 是評判，attracting 是吸引，interrupting 是打斷。
正解：D　encouraging
exam103.translation: 他真是個啦啦隊，總是鼓勵我、叫我不要放棄。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: So far scientists haven’t been able to accurately ______ when an earthquake will happen.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：到目前為止，科學家還無法準確預測地震何時發生。
片語／單字：
- so far：到目前為止
- predict：預測
- agree：同意
- attend：出席
- connect：連接
predict when 是預測何時。agree 是同意，attend 是參加，connect 是連接。
正解：A　predict
exam103.translation: 到目前為止，科學家還無法準確預測地震何時發生。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: Amy is under great pressure because she is afraid that she cannot meet her parents’ ______.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：Amy 壓力很大，因為她怕達不到父母的期望。
片語／單字：
- meet one's expectations：達到某人的期望
- under pressure：承受壓力
- results：結果
- expectations：期望
- solutions：解決方法
- examinations：考試
meet expectations 是達到期望。results 是結果，solutions 是解決辦法，examinations 是考試。
正解：B　expectations
exam103.translation: Amy 壓力很大，因為她怕達不到父母的期望。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: Richard’s new invention is now on a ______ line, so people will be able to buy it soon.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：Richard 的新發明已經上生產線，所以人們很快就能買到。
片語／單字：
- production line：生產線
- production：生產
- discovery：發現
- rescue：救援
- repair：修理
on a production line 是在生產線上。discovery 是發現，rescue 是救援，repair 是修理。
正解：A　production
exam103.translation: Richard 的新發明已經上生產線，所以人們很快就能買到。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: Taking regular exercise and avoiding late night snacks can ______ you from getting fat.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：規律運動並避免宵夜，可以防止你變胖。
片語／單字：
- prevent ... from：防止
- late night snacks：宵夜
- prefer：比較喜歡
- preserve：保存
- prevent：防止
- prepare：準備
prevent you from 是防止你。prefer 是偏好，preserve 是保存，prepare 是準備。
正解：C　prevent
exam103.translation: 規律運動並避免宵夜，可以防止你變胖。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: Online shopping is a ______ way to make purchases, especially for people who are too busy to go shopping.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：網購是方便的購物方式，尤其對忙到沒時間出門的人。
片語／單字：
- online shopping：網購
- make purchases：購物
- responsible：負責的
- convenient：方便的
- local：當地的
- mental：心理的
too busy to go shopping 所以方便的是 convenient。responsible 是負責的，local 是當地的，mental 是心理的。
正解：B　convenient
exam103.translation: 網購是方便的購物方式，尤其對忙到沒時間出門的人。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: ______ all the animals in the Taipei Zoo, the pandas are visited the most.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：台北動物園所有動物之中，熊貓被參觀得最多。
片語／單字：
- of all：在所有……之中
- By：藉由
- Of：在……之中
- Above：在……之上
- Beyond：超出
Of all 是「在所有……之中」。By 是藉由，Above 是在上方，Beyond 是超出。
正解：B　Of
exam103.translation: 台北動物園所有動物之中，熊貓被參觀得最多。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: Tom ______ to the movie with us for sure. He has already bought his ticket.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：Tom 一定會和我們去看電影。他已經買了票。
片語／單字：
- for sure：一定
- buy a ticket：買票
- will go：將會去
- has gone：已經去了
- goes：去（現在習慣）
- went：去了
已經買票，所以是未來 will go。goes 是習慣，went 是過去，has gone 是已經去了，和 for sure 還沒出發不合。
正解：C　will go
exam103.translation: Tom 一定會和我們去看電影。他已經買了票。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: It’s difficult for me to spend time with ______ use a lot of foul language.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：我很難和那些說很多髒話的人相處。
片語／單字：
- foul language：髒話
- spend time with：和……相處
- one who：一個……的人
- people who：……的人們
- who：誰（缺先行詞）
- whom：誰（受格）
people who use 是「使用髒話的人」。who 前面缺先行詞，whom 是受格，one who 文法上不如 people who 自然，而且 who 的先行詞要是人。
正解：D　people who
exam103.translation: 我很難和那些說很多髒話的人相處。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: Part of the film Transformers: Age of Extinction ______ on location in China, to attract more Chinese moviegoers.
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：電影《變形金剛：絕跡重生》有一部分在中國取景，以吸引更多中國觀眾。
片語／單字：
- on location：實地取景
- be shot：被拍攝
- was shot：被拍攝
- was shooting：正在拍攝
- shot：拍攝（過去式主動）
- shoot：拍攝（原形）
電影是被拍攝，用 was shot。shot / shoot 是主動，was shooting 是正在拍。
正解：C　was shot
exam103.translation: 電影《變形金剛：絕跡重生》有一部分在中國取景，以吸引更多中國觀眾。

exam103.subject: en
exam103.stem: I don’t see ______. I’ve finished my work!
choices: A. what else can I do for now
B. how can I make you satisfied
C. that I can’t play the video games
D. why I can’t go out with my friends
exam103.explain:
整句中譯：我不明白為什麼我不能和朋友出去。我的工作已經做完了！
片語／單字：
- why I can't：為什麼我不能
- what else can I do for now：我現在還能做什麼（倒裝）
- how can I make you satisfied：我要怎樣才能讓你滿意（倒裝）
- that I can’t play the video games：我不能打電動
- why I can’t go out with my friends：為什麼我不能和朋友出去
see 後面用直述語序 why I can't。A、B 還是倒裝，C 的 that I can't 和「工作做完了想出去」的語氣不合。
正解：D　why I can’t go out with my friends
exam103.translation: 我不明白為什麼我不能和朋友出去。我的工作已經做完了！

phrases.zh: 我現在還能做什麼（倒裝）

phrases.zh: 我要怎樣才能讓你滿意（倒裝）
